w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: The landlord is stamping the ground. Each stamp lands like a gavel. The tiles it marks start to feel wrong under your feet.

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 Daniyar walks you through Spool. (Monster codex: observed.)

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Chorus Line is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Terms of Service: Read the fine print — find the loophole. Clauses write themselves and unanswered ones auto-accept, the penalties landing unread. Spend turns examining the scroll and you will find the loophole clause that dismisses it outright. (Striking the scroll just gives it more to bill you for.) (Negash lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. The Callback is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w5Mentions.name: The Cancellation
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Cancellation.
firstContext: 💛 You hold Contract Quill. It has signed three leases, two loans, and one terrible contract you still regret. The penmanship was always excellent. The judgment, less so. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they have carried you this far. The feast was the weapon.
Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
Something moves out there — The Cancellation.
Something big is moving in the woods. The birds went quiet.
👁️ Tiana freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."

w5Mentions.name: The Editor
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Editor.
firstContext: 📓 Codex: Counter: Go off-script — It can only cancel what is IN the script — the stamp descends for three rounds before it falls. Go off-script: improvise, use your abilities in ways never intended, and there is nothing to cancel. (Or spend audience favor — the audience can overrule a cancellation.
Travel 2 tiles to trail edge.
Something moves out there — The Editor.
👁️ Aroha freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
💬 Zoey: "Huh. Never been this way before."

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Rerun.
firstContext: This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
Travel 2 tiles to forest floor.

💬 Lena: "Smell that? Something's different here."

w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Spoiler.
firstContext: 🤝 Lena is 👁️ Scout now. Sees trouble first. Warns the party on the road.

w5Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Timeslot is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)
firstContext: 🍖 FEAST 📺 — Owen opens the pantry wide: 3× Foraged food, 1× Foraged food, 1× Foraged food. Negash, Tom eat until the fire burns low. Somebody tells the story again, the one everybody already knows. For one evening, hunger feels like a rumor. (−1,598 kcal from the pantry) The channeled keepsake fee
🍖 FEASTED ×2.53 until tomorrow's dawn (6 parts left): a proper feast. A channeled keepsake feeds the flames (devotion ×1.5). Arc IV burns hotter. Strikes and abilities hit with the feast behind them.

🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Timeslot is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)
"Can we talk?" Tom sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to." (Talk to Tom.)
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: A lean scout waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
Rain. You dance. It works. +1L clean water. (rain_dancer)
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.

For one evening, nobody is surviving — they're just together. (−1,744 kcal from the pantry) The channeled keepsake fee

⛔ THE COMMERCIAL BREAK does not notice you the way prey notices a hunter. The march needs 20 allied blades (you have 0). Sound the call. This is not courage. This is arithmetic.
Tiana left 3 branches by the stash. No announcement. That's how it works here.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A full seat. global standing, every wave faced, the deeds complete. The table rises when you enter. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 34 → 24 · capped · Craft 12 · Talk 19 · Explore 40 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Aroha Ngata ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,173 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.
